title: smime-tree: P-384 CA chain limitation must be in crate-level docs, not buried in cert.rs comment
description: The pkix-chain DefaultVerifier only validates RSA-PKCS1v15-SHA256 and ECDSA-P256-SHA256 CA signatures. Any chain through a P-384 intermediate CA fails with CertChainError::SignatureVerification. Real-world CAs (DigiCert, Comodo) frequently use P-384 intermediates. This hard operational limitation is only mentioned in a cert.rs module comment; it must be prominently documented in lib.rs at the crate level.
